schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE node (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  type TEXT NOT NULL,
  label TEXT NOT NULL,
  props TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  first_seen TEXT NOT NULL,
  last_seen TEXT NOT NULL
, retired_at TEXT)

CREATE TABLE edge (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  src TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES node(id),
  dst TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES node(id),
  rel TEXT NOT NULL,
  props TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  confidence REAL NOT NULL,
  tier TEXT,
  source TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_record TEXT,
  source_fetched_at TEXT,
  first_seen TEXT NOT NULL,
  last_seen TEXT NOT NULL,
  retired_at TEXT
)

CREATE TABLE edge_change (
  change_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  edge_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  change_type TEXT NOT NULL,          -- added | attribute_changed | retired | restored
  field TEXT,
  old_value TEXT,
  new_value TEXT,
  changed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  build_id TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE build (
  build_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  sources TEXT NOT NULL,
  node_count INTEGER,
  edge_count INTEGER,
  added INTEGER, changed INTEGER, retired INTEGER, restored INTEGER
)
